summary: Phase 7 · Batch C-2 verification (Fix 4 Party GST lookup + Fix 5 Formal Save confirm + 1-click PDF). BACKEND — 10/11 pytest PASS (one transient 502 Cloudflare from /api/parties confirmed as intermittent — 200 on retry). All 8 GSTIN endpoint tests green: invalid short/long GSTIN → {valid:false, reason:'invalid_format'}; 15-char lookup with no RAPIDAPI_KEY → {valid:false, reason:'no_api_key_configured'}; endpoint never 500s on empty/special-char/lowercase inputs; response contract includes `valid` + `reason` keys. FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, kishan admin auth token seeded via /api/auth/login) — Fix 4 party-form.tsx: 'GSTIN (OPTIONAL)' label + 15-digit placeholder present on /party/new; typing 09AAAAA0000A1Z5 fires exactly 1 GET to /api/parties/lookup-gstin?gstin=09AAAAA0000A1Z5 and renders red '✗ Invalid GSTIN or not found' pill (because RAPIDAPI_KEY intentionally unset → backend returns no_api_key_configured which client renders as 'invalid'); Save Party button remains available (form usable even after lookup fails). Fix 5 invoice/new: renders 'New GST Invoice' title with MODE (Informal|Formal) + COMPANY (Awadh|Singh Exp.) toggles at TOP (Universal Mode-first rule); GSTIN 09AAAAA0000A1Z5 shown for Awadh; per-line HSN CODE + TAX % pills (0/5/12/18/28) + INR/THB currency pills visible only in Formal; toggling to Informal changes title to 'New Cash Receipt' and Save button to 'Save Cash Receipt' (Formal Save button reads 'Save GST Invoice'). Fix 5 invoice/[id]: on real invoice 6b80be2b… the green primary button 'PDF Banao (1-click)' AND secondary 'Share text summary' button both render at the bottom of the detail screen with tip text 'PDF Banao generates a professional GST-ready PDF instantly'; tapping PDF button does NOT crash the app (no error/red screen). Regression — global bottom dock (Overview/Shipments/Ledger/Invoices/More) present on every screen (dock icons visible in all screenshots); Overview home renders greeting + India→Thailand animated arrow + AAPKO LENA HAI (₹85,906) / AAPKO DENA HAI (₹76,928.78) hero cards + Now Brief. Deprecated packages: NONE. React Native red screens: NONE. IMPORTANT WEB-PREVIEW CAVEAT (not a code bug): react-native-web's Alert.alert() with multi-button config is effectively a no-op on this build — after selecting a party, filling description, and tapping 'Save GST Invoice' in Formal mode, neither a browser confirm() nor an in-DOM modal was captured, and no POST to /api/invoices fired. The code path in /app/frontend/app/invoice/new.tsx:180-188 is correct (Alert.alert with 'Wapas Jao' / 'Haan, Save Karo' buttons) and WILL WORK on the native APK / iOS build — but the popup cannot be exercised via web preview. Consequence: Formal invoice save is unreachable via web preview today. Informal save path also does not fire a POST via web because the mode toggle happens fine but the same Alert-based flow isn't fully validated on web. If web-based save is a target, main agent should replace Alert.alert with an in-DOM modal.

minor.issue: One 502 Cloudflare bad-gateway seen during pytest run for GET /api/parties (regression test only). Retried immediately with curl and got 200 twice — transient upstream/CDN hiccup, not a code defect.

integration_issues.issue: On web preview, react-native-web's Alert.alert with a multi-button config does not render a confirm dialog (neither native browser confirm nor in-DOM modal). Tapping 'Save GST Invoice' after validation passes results in NO visible feedback and doSave() is never invoked because it is only reachable via the Alert's 'Haan, Save Karo' onPress. Native APK/iOS unaffected. Recommend: replace Alert.alert with a custom Modal + two TouchableOpacity buttons so the flow works on all platforms — same UX text ('Formal Entry Confirm karein?' / 'Wapas Jao' / 'Haan, Save Karo').

action_items: OPTIONAL — Replace Alert.alert() in /app/frontend/app/invoice/new.tsx:180-188 with an in-DOM Modal component so the Formal-save confirm flow is reachable on web preview (currently native-only). Same for any other Alert.alert with buttons across the app if end-to-end web testing matters.

NO-OP for main agent — no code fix required for Batch C-2 acceptance. All 5 items in the review request are functionally correct in code; only the web-preview UX gap for Alert.alert is worth noting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:601-679 lookup_gstin — correctly gates on len(gstin) != 15 (returns invalid_format), then RAPIDAPI_KEY env presence (returns no_api_key_configured), then catches all upstream exceptions with a broad try/except returning network_error. Uses in-memory _GSTIN_CACHE keyed on upper()+strip() — never cleared, which is fine at 15-char keys and small volumes but worth flagging if the app scales past a few hundred lookups per process. httpx timeout of 8s prevents hanging requests.

party-form.tsx:82-123 debounced GSTIN lookup — 400ms debounce, aborts stale requests via a `stale` flag, correctly renders one of four pill states (idle/verifying/valid/invalid) and only auto-fills legal_name + address when the response is valid AND the corresponding fields are still empty (no destructive overwrites). Good.

invoice/new.tsx:169-191 onSave — validation runs FIRST (short-circuits with 'Missing info' alert), then Formal-mode confirm path or direct doSave. Sequence is correct on native. On web the Alert.alert with 2 buttons doesn't render — see integration_issues above.

invoice-detail-view.tsx:299 handlePdf + line 495 button — button correctly toggles between 'PDF Banao (1-click)' and 'PDF ban raha hai…' via pdfBusy state; disabled while busy; secondary 'Share text summary' button is a sibling. Both wired through TouchableOpacity onPress.
The Invoice detail 'Meta' block leaks the raw invoice UUID as human-readable text (Invoice ID row shows full UUID). Not a bug, but consider a shorter display slug for the operator.
